principle_violations.reason: The VolumeCalculator class overrides the sum method to change its behavior based on Shape implementations that can't calculate volume. This design requires modifying classes to extend functionality, violating the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use different interfaces or abstract classes for Shape implementations that support only area calculations while others support both area and volume. Alternatively, handle the NotImplementedError exceptions where they might occur.
